issue.title: test_contending_detections_notify_and_increment_exactly_once misses the usage-limit inbox row under the scoped xdist lane
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/test_llm_provider_usage_limit_disable_notification.py::TestUsageLimitNotification::test_contending_detections_notify_and_increment_exactly_once`
- **Repro:** `sase tool run check` (scoped xdist lane). Isolation: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_llm_provider_usage_limit_disable_notification.py::TestUsageLimitNotification::test_contending_detections_notify_and_increment_exactly_once`

Failed once in `sase tool run d5aa010ce2ae970431d954712875629c` (scoped pytest, 14 workers): `assert 0 == 1` on `len(notifications)` for `sender == "llm.usage_limit"`. Earlier assertions in the same call passed: `errors == []`, `stored["claude"].source == "usage_limit"`, `increments == ["claude"]`. The disable write and metric increment succeeded exactly once; the inbox row was missing.

Passed twice in isolation on the same tree immediately after (3.21s, then 2.19s). This tree did not change `src/sase/llm_provider/usage_limit_disable.py` or `notify_provider_usage_limit_disabled`; `_notify_usage_limit_disabled` swallows notification exceptions, so a racy store write can leave the disable in place with zero inbox rows.

Did not reproduce serially. Fail rate observed: 1/3 across one xdist check plus two isolated reruns.
